osool-105-i4.name: For the sauce: white sauce (ghee, flour and milk or broth)

osool-105-i5.name: For the sauce: finely chopped parsley

instructions.1: Clean and blanch the head and remove the brain and tongue as for lamb head.
instructions.2: Put the head on the heat, cover with cold water and add the chopped vegetables and the tongue.
instructions.3: Simmer over low heat until tender, skimming off the scum whenever it appears.
instructions.4: Add the cleaned brain, tied in cheesecloth, twenty minutes before the end of cooking.
instructions.5: Make the white sauce (1 tablespoon ghee and 1 tablespoon flour per cup of liquid) and stir in the chopped parsley while it is hot.
instructions.6: Lift out the head, place it on a plate and remove the bones while keeping its shape as far as possible, then cover it with the parsley sauce.
instructions.7: Garnish with the tongue cut into rounds, lemon and pieces of brain.
instructions.8: Cold veal head: boil the head the same way and let it cool, then remove the bone and arrange the meat on a plate over a bed of shredded lettuce; garnish with the tongue, tomatoes, green olives and onion, and serve with French dressing.

osool-106.title: Veal Trotters with Egg and Cream Sauce

osool-106-i3.name: Carrot, onion and a piece of white celery

osool-106-i4.name: Flour dissolved in a little water

osool-106-i5.name: Light white sauce made with the cooking broth

instructions.1: Scrape the hair off the trotters, scrub them with a loofah and soap, rinse several times, then wash with flour.
instructions.2: Split the hoof and crack the bone crosswise without separating the pieces, then blanch by putting them in cold water, bringing it to a boil and draining.
instructions.3: Boil them in water with the vegetables, seasoning and the well-mixed flour until tender.
instructions.4: Remove the bones and arrange the meat on a plate.
instructions.5: Make the light white sauce from the cooking broth.
instructions.6: Beat the egg yolks and add them to the sauce, stirring well, then heat gently for 3 minutes while stirring without letting it boil; add the lemon juice.
instructions.7: Cover the meat with the sauce and garnish the plate with the fried bread triangles.

osool-107.title: Cold Trotters with Parsley and Vinegar Dressing

osool-107-i9.name: Shredded lettuce, tomatoes and lemon, for serving

instructions.1: Clean and blanch the trotters as for veal trotters with egg and cream sauce.
instructions.2: Boil the trotters with the water and vegetables until completely tender.
instructions.3: Remove the bones and let the meat cool.
instructions.4: Mix the dressing ingredients (oil, vinegar, parsley, onion, salt and pepper) and marinate the cold meat in it for at least half an hour, turning from time to time.
instructions.5: Lift the meat out of the dressing and arrange it on a plate over a bed of shredded lettuce; garnish with tomatoes and lemon.

osool-108-i7.name: White sauce or parsley sauce (1 tablespoon ghee and 1 tablespoon flour per cup of milk)

instructions.1: Remove the membrane and blood vessels, rub the brains gently with salt and flour and rinse well.
instructions.2: Put the brains in a pot of salted water and leave for 20 minutes, then bring the pot to a boil for 5 minutes. You can wrap the brains in a piece of cloth before putting them on the heat.
instructions.3: Rinse the brains in cold water, then put them back on the heat with fresh water and boil for 5 to 10 minutes with the onion, salt, lemon juice, mastic and cardamom.
instructions.4: Lift them out of the water and let them cool, then cut as desired or leave whole.
instructions.5: Serve covered with white sauce or parsley sauce, or garnished with lemon and parsley.

instructions.1: Wash the tongue well and scrape it with a knife to remove the rough outer layer.
instructions.2: Rub it well with salt, then with flour, and rinse repeatedly.
instructions.3: Put it in a pot, cover with cold water and bring to a boil over low heat for 5 minutes, then change the water for fresh cold water.
instructions.4: Return it to low heat and add the salt, the onion and a piece of cheesecloth holding the cardamom, cloves and peppercorns.
instructions.5: Leave it on the heat until tender, then lift out the tongue and peel off its skin.
instructions.6: Serve it whole and hot, garnished with lemon and parsley.
instructions.7: Or let it cool, cut it into rounds, cover with mayonnaise and garnish with lettuce and a few pickles.
instructions.8: Or cut it into cubes, cover with lemon-parsley sauce (white sauce made with white stock, lemon juice and chopped parsley) and serve hot.
instructions.9: Or sauté the boiled tongue in ghee, then lift it out, cut into rounds and serve with lemon and tomato slices.

osool-110-i3.name: Onion rubbed with salt and pepper

osool-110-i5.name: White sauce, or celery or parsley sauce

instructions.1: Gently rub the sweetbreads with salt to draw out the blood, then clean them, wash with flour and clean again.
instructions.2: Put them in a pot, cover with salted cold water and bring to a boil for 5 minutes, then drain.
instructions.3: Pour fresh cold water over them and set over low heat with an onion rubbed with salt and pepper; cook until tender.
instructions.4: Serve hot, covered with white sauce and garnished with parsley, or covered with celery sauce or parsley sauce.

osool-111-i2.name: Flour, soap and a loofah for cleaning

osool-111-i6.name: For the onion sauce: white sauce

osool-111-i7.name: For the onion sauce: large onions

osool-111-i8.name: Lemons cut in halves, for serving

instructions.1: Scrape off the dark-colored parts and remove the fatty pieces.
instructions.2: Scrub the tripe well with a loofah and soap and rinse repeatedly, then rub it with flour and rinse with cold water.
instructions.3: Cut it as desired, put it in a pot, cover with cold water and bring to a boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Drain off the boiling water, replace it with fresh water and repeat once more.
instructions.5: Cover with cold water with the onion, mastic and cardamom and cook until nearly done, then add the salt and continue cooking until fully tender.
instructions.6: For the onion sauce: peel and boil the onions, then lift them out of the water, drain, chop, add to the white sauce and season.
instructions.7: Serve the tripe hot with salt, pepper and halved lemons, or cut it up and cover with the onion sauce.

osool-112-i5.name: For the sauce: strained cooking broth

instructions.1: Wash the spleens with flour and clean them well.
instructions.2: Season with salt, pepper and half the lemon juice and leave for about a quarter of an hour.
instructions.3: Put them in a pot, cover with water and add the onion, the rest of the lemon juice and a little salt; bring to a boil, then lower the heat and cook until tender.
instructions.4: Lift them out of the water; mix the sauce ingredients (broth, oil and lemon) and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.5: Cut into thick slices, arrange on a plate, garnish with lemon and parsley and serve with the sauce.
instructions.6: Or sauté briefly in very hot ghee and serve with parsley and lemon, keeping the frying pan covered because spleen spatters; turn it over, then cover again.

osool-113-i3.name: Onion rubbed with salt and pepper

instructions.1: Rub the lung with salt and wash it, then rub with flour and rinse.
instructions.2: Cut into suitable pieces, put in cold water and bring to a boil over low heat for 5 minutes, then drain.
instructions.3: Put them in fresh cold water, repeat the process and drain.
instructions.4: Put them in fresh cold water with the onion rubbed with salt and pepper and a little cardamom, and cook until tender.
instructions.5: Arrange on a plate and garnish with parsley and lemon.

osool-114-i5.name: Dried parsley leaves, a little thyme and bay leaf

instructions.1: Remove the bones and the skin layer from the meat and flatten it well.
instructions.2: Season it, then roll it up tightly and tie with kitchen string.
instructions.3: Put the prepared vegetables and the spice bundle in a pot with just enough water to cover the vegetables, place the meat on top and cover with greased paper.
instructions.4: Cook over low heat with the lid tightly closed, turning from time to time, until the meat is tender.
instructions.5: Lift out the meat, place it between two boards or trays, press it under a weight and leave until completely cold, then cut into thin slices.

osool-115.title: Veal Rolls with Brown Sauce and Mashed Potatoes

instructions.1: Cut the meat into steak slices 3 inches long and 2 inches wide and flatten them well.
instructions.2: Roll each slice up like a stuffed roll and tie with string, then marinate in the onion juice, salt, pepper, cloves, nutmeg and lemon for half an hour.
instructions.3: Brown the meat in the ghee and lift it out, then brown the flour in the same ghee until it turns brown.
instructions.4: Take the pot off the heat and add the stock gradually, stirring constantly, then add the marinade juices and bring to a boil, still stirring.
instructions.5: Add the meat and simmer over low heat until tender, then remove the string from the rolls.
instructions.6: Make a bed of mashed potatoes and arrange the cooked meat on top; strain the sauce, pour it around the dish and serve hot.

osool-116.title: Stuffed Beef Rolls with Tomato Sauce and Rice

osool-116-i4.name: Light baladi bread, soaked and squeezed

osool-116-i11.name: Carrot and a piece of celery, chopped

instructions.1: Pound the meat and cut it into rectangles (3 × 2 inches).
instructions.2: Wash the meat and season it with salt, pepper, nutmeg and onion juice.
instructions.3: Mix the minced meat, garlic, parsley and squeezed bread and season everything well.
instructions.4: Spread the minced meat mixture over the steak slices, roll each piece up and tie with string, then brown the meat in the ghee and lift it out.
instructions.5: Add the strained tomatoes to the ghee left from browning and cook until done, then add the vinegar and the stock or water and bring to a boil.
instructions.6: Add the meat and chopped vegetables and cook until the meat is tender.
instructions.7: Place the cooked rice on a plate in a hollow ring; lift the meat out of the sauce, remove the string and place it in the center of the rice.
instructions.8: Strain the remaining sauce, season it and pour it over the meat.

instructions.1: Brown the meat in the ghee and lift it out, then brown the onions and lift them out.
instructions.2: Brown the flour in the remaining ghee until it turns brown, then take the pot off the heat and add the stock gradually, stirring well.
instructions.3: Return the pot to the heat and let it boil for 3 minutes.
instructions.4: Layer the meat, onions and carrots alternately in a tagine dish, pour the strained brown sauce over them, cover and bake in a moderate oven until the meat is tender.
instructions.5: Wrap a folded napkin or a paper frill fixed with a pin around the tagine and serve it on a larger plate.

osool-118.title: Lamb in White Sauce with Peas and Carrots

instructions.1: Sauté the meat in the ghee, then add the water and cook until nearly tender.
instructions.2: Mix the flour well with the milk and add it to the meat while stirring.
instructions.3: Leave the pot over low heat until the meat is fully cooked, then add half the vegetables and boil for 3 minutes.
instructions.4: Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice, ladle onto a plate and garnish with the rest of the carrots and peas.

instructions.1: Add a little salt to the onions and stir over medium heat until they absorb their liquid and turn golden; add a very little water and stir until it is absorbed, and repeat until they are fully browned, then add the ghee and stir for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Add the strained tomato and the meat and stir everything over low heat for 10 minutes, then pour in a little water and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Put the onions and meat into a tagine dish, cover and bake in the oven.
instructions.4: Remove the lid shortly before it is done so the top can brown.
instructions.5: Wrap a paper frill around the tagine, fix it with a pin and serve on a plate.

instructions.1: Separate the tail joints, then split each one crosswise with a cleaver.
instructions.2: Wash the joints well and put them into boiling water with a whole onion; cook until nearly tender, then add salt and boil for about 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Brown the chopped onions with a little salt over medium heat, sprinkling with a little of the oxtail broth whenever they dry out, until fully browned; then add the ghee and stir for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Add the strained tomato and the boiled oxtail joints and stir everything for 10 minutes, then pour in a little of the oxtail broth and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Put everything into a tagine dish, cover and bake in the oven until done, removing the lid at the end so the top browns.
instructions.6: Serve the tagine on a larger plate.

instructions.1: Brown the meat in the ghee and lift it out, then brown the onions and lift them out.
instructions.2: Add the strained tomatoes to the remaining ghee and cook until done.
instructions.3: Pour in the water or stock and bring to a boil.
instructions.4: Add the meat and onions and season; cover the pot, lower the heat and cook until tender.

osool-122-i7.name: Cooking apple or green tomato, chopped

osool-122-i11.name: Sugar, or 1 teaspoon jam or raisins

instructions.1: Cover the coconut with the water and heat gently for an hour, then strain off the coconut milk and discard the coconut.
instructions.2: Brown the meat lightly in the ghee and lift it out.
instructions.3: Fry the onion in the remaining ghee until golden, then add the curry powder and stir briefly.
instructions.4: Add the flour and stir until it browns slightly, then add the apple and stir everything well.
instructions.5: Add the stock and coconut milk gradually, stirring constantly, and bring to a boil; then lower the heat and add the sugar.
instructions.6: Put the browned meat into the sauce and simmer over low heat until tender, one to two hours, skimming off the fat whenever it appears; season the sauce and add the lemon juice.
instructions.7: Place the boiled rice on a plate in a hollow ring with the curried meat in the middle; garnish with lemon and parsley and serve the rest of the sauce in a sauceboat.
instructions.8: Curry with cooked meat: make the curry sauce and simmer it over low heat for an hour to bring out the flavor of its ingredients, then add chopped cooked meat, boil for a quarter of an hour and serve as above.

osool-123-i1.name: Veal (one flattened piece of breast or leg)

osool-123-i6.name: Salt, pepper and nutmeg or ground cinnamon

instructions.1: Spread out the meat and pound it to break the fibers, no more than half an inch thick, then season with salt, pepper and nutmeg or cinnamon.
instructions.2: Spread the sausage over it, leaving half an inch free at the edges.
instructions.3: Roll it up tightly into a cylinder and tie with linen kitchen string.
instructions.4: Put the chopped vegetables in a pot and pour over just enough water to cover them.
instructions.5: Place the meat on top of the vegetables and cook over low heat or in the oven, keeping it covered.
instructions.6: Every half hour, lift the lid, turn the meat over and add a little water if needed; cook until done (about two hours), then lift it out and remove the string.
instructions.7: Serve cold, brushed with glaze and garnished with lettuce and tomatoes, with a vegetable salad.
instructions.8: Or serve hot with a brown sauce made from the vegetable broth it cooked in, garnished with boiled carrots.
instructions.9: Meat stuffed with spiced mince and pine nuts: replace the sausage with spiced minced meat mixed with a few pine nuts and proceed the same way.

osool-124.title: Veal Stuffed with Tail Fat and Garlic

osool-124-i2.name: Sheep tail fat, cut into small pieces

instructions.1: Spread out the meat, pound it, then season with salt, pepper and allspice.
instructions.2: Push half garlic cloves into the meat at intervals.
instructions.3: Scatter the tail fat over the surface of the meat, then roll it up and tie with linen string.
instructions.4: Sauté the meat in the ghee, then add a little water and cover the pot.
instructions.5: Lift the lid from time to time, turn the meat and add a little water, and continue until the meat is tender.
instructions.6: Lift it out of the pot, remove the string and place it on a plate with its cooking juices around it; garnish with the boiled potatoes, or serve cold garnished with parsley or lettuce and a few tomatoes.

osool-125-i1.name: Young veal, cut into medium pieces

osool-125-i2.name: A piece of celery, an onion and a carrot

osool-125-i3.name: Cloves, cardamom and black peppercorns in cheesecloth

osool-125-i4.name: For the white sauce: ghee and flour

instructions.1: Cut the meat into even, medium-sized pieces, and the vegetables the same way.
instructions.2: Put the meat, vegetables and spices in a pot with enough stock or water to cover them; cover the pot and cook over low heat until the meat is tender.
instructions.3: Make a thick white sauce with 3 cups of the remaining cooking liquid and boil it well.
instructions.4: Take the sauce off the heat until it cools slightly, then add the cream and lemon juice and season; reheat over low heat, stirring constantly.
instructions.5: Arrange the meat on a warm plate, cover it with the thick sauce and garnish with lemon and parsley.

osool-126.title: Liver in Tomato Sauce with Garlic and Vinegar

osool-126-i10.name: Salt and pepper (a little chili can be added)

instructions.1: Wash the liver, cut it into medium-thick slices and marinate in salt, pepper, lemon juice and onion juice for half an hour.
instructions.2: Coat in flour, fry in very hot oil and lift out.
instructions.3: Fry the chopped garlic in 2 tablespoons of the remaining oil, then add the strained tomatoes and cook until done; add the vinegar and a little water and season the sauce.
instructions.4: Cut the fried liver slices into cubes, add them to the sauce and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.
instructions.5: Ladle out and garnish with parsley.

instructions.1: Wash the liver and cut it into slices, then put it in a pot and season with salt, pepper, lemon juice and onion juice; leave for about an hour.
instructions.2: Put the pot on the heat and stir the liver until it reabsorbs its juices, then add the ghee, brown it lightly and lift it out of the pot.
instructions.3: Fry the chopped onion in the remaining ghee; when it turns golden, add the flour and keep stirring until it turns brown, then add the stock or water gradually, stirring well.
instructions.4: Bring the sauce to a boil over low heat, then add the browned liver, cover the pot and cook until tender.
instructions.5: Ladle out, cover with the sauce and garnish with lemon and parsley.

osool-128-i7.name: For the brown sauce: stock or water

instructions.1: Cut the prepared tripe into rectangles (3 × 2 inches), roll them up, tie and season.
instructions.2: Put the seasoned chopped vegetables in a pot, cover with a little water and place the tripe rolls, seasoned with salt and pepper, on top.
instructions.3: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until the tripe is tender, then remove the string.
instructions.4: For the brown sauce: brown the flour in the ghee until reddish brown, then add the stock gradually, stirring well; bring to a boil and strain.
instructions.5: Make a bed of potato purée, arrange the tripe rolls on top, pour the sauce around them and garnish with a few carrots.
instructions.6: Tripe in tomato sauce: brown a chopped onion in 1 tablespoon ghee, add 4 chopped garlic cloves and stir until golden, then add 1 cup strained tomatoes and cook until done, followed by 1 cup of the tripe broth; season, add the boiled, chopped tripe and simmer over low heat for half an hour.

osool-129.title: Stuffed Tripe with Vegetables and Tomatoes

instructions.1: Clean the tripe and cut it into rectangles (3 × 2 inches).
instructions.2: Mince the leftover tripe trimmings, add the garlic and parsley and season with salt and pepper; stuff the tripe pieces with this mixture, roll them up and tie.
instructions.3: Put the vegetables in a pot, cover with the stock and tomatoes and season, then place the tripe rolls on top.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and cook in a moderate oven until tender, adding some water if needed.
instructions.5: Lift out the tripe, remove the string, arrange on a warm plate and strain the sauce over it.

osool-130.title: Brains in Parsley and Lemon Sauce

instructions.1: Clean the brains and parboil them as for boiled brains.
instructions.2: Make the white sauce, add the brains and simmer over low heat until cooked.
instructions.3: Take the pot off the heat, lift out the brains and place them on a warm plate.
instructions.4: Add the parsley and lemon juice to the sauce, season well and pour it over the brains.

instructions.1: Brown the onion in the ghee, then add the garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.2: Add the strained tomatoes and cook until done, then add the vinegar and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the trotter broth, season and bring to a boil (this is the dama sauce).
instructions.4: Remove as much of the bone from the trotters as possible, then put them in the sauce, cover the pot and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes.
instructions.5: Arrange the trotters on a warm plate and pour the sauce around them.
instructions.6: Lungs in tomato sauce: made the same way, using boiled, chopped lamb lung instead of the trotters.

instructions.1: Mix all the ingredients and pound them well in a mortar.
instructions.2: Shape into fingers or rounds and fry lightly in very hot ghee.
instructions.3: Lift out of the ghee, arrange on a plate and garnish with parsley.
instructions.4: Meat and liver kofta: made with the same ingredients, adding ⅛ kg minced liver to the mixture.

osool-133-i2.name: Asag (minced meat cooked with onion and ghee)

instructions.1: For the asag: mix ½ kg coarsely minced meat with a sliced onion, season and stir over low heat until it absorbs its juices; add a little water and let it be absorbed, then add 1 tablespoon ghee and stir until the meat browns slightly.
instructions.2: Mix all the ingredients except the eggs and pass them through the fine plate of a mincer.
instructions.3: Knead well with the eggs, shape as desired and fry in very hot ghee.
instructions.4: Serve arranged on a plate and garnished with parsley.
instructions.5: Kofta with boiled rice: add 2 tablespoons of boiled rice to the mixture after mincing and before binding with egg; shape into medium-thick rounds and fry, or coat in egg before frying, and serve with tomato sauce.

osool-134.title: Leftover Meat and Potato Kofta
osool-134.culturalNotes: An economical way to use up leftover boiled or cooked meat.

instructions.1: Mince the cooked meat, mix all the ingredients together and bind with the egg.
instructions.2: Shape into patties or fingers as desired.
instructions.3: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and fry in very hot ghee.
instructions.4: Serve garnished with parsley, or with tomato sauce.

osool-135.title: Fried Lamb Chops (Costoletta)
osool-135.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-135-i5.name: Fried potatoes, or potato purée and sautéed peas, for serving

instructions.1: Prepare and wash the meat; scrape the meat off the top of the bone for about an inch and trim the excess fat, then beat the meat to break the fibers and give it its shape.
instructions.2: Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice, and onion juice if desired.
instructions.3: Pat the meat dry and fry it in the very hot ghee, turning it quickly on both sides at first to seal the surface, then lower the heat until cooked through.
instructions.4: Lift the meat out and drain it thoroughly of ghee; serve hot with fried potatoes or sautéed peas, or with potato purée and tomato or brown sauce.
instructions.5: Second method: coat the prepared meat in seasoned flour (1 tablespoon flour with ½ teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon pepper) and fry in ghee as above; serve with potato purée, pour the sauce around and garnish with sautéed vegetables.
instructions.6: Third method: lightly beat an egg with a little salt and pepper and dip the chops in it, then coat in 3 tablespoons fine breadcrumbs, pressing with a knife, and fry in ghee; put a paper frill on the end of each bone or wrap it in foil.

osool-136.title: Mock Cutlets from Cooked Minced Meat
osool-136.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-136-i3.name: Very thick white sauce (panada): ghee, flour and milk
osool-136-i3.standardAmount: 2 tablespoons ghee and 2 tablespoons flour per cup of milk; use half this amount

osool-136-i5.name: Small pieces of macaroni for the 'bone'

instructions.1: Make the very thick sauce and mix it with the cooked minced meat and parsley; knead well and season.
instructions.2: Spread the mixture in a greased dish in a round and leave to cool, then cut it into four pieces.
instructions.3: Shape each piece like a cutlet and insert a piece of macaroni into its pointed end.
instructions.4: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and deep-fry.
instructions.5: Serve with potato purée and brown sauce or tomato sauce, or on their own garnished with parsley.

osool-137.title: Lamb Chops with Spaghetti, Tomato and Cheese
osool-137.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-137-i7.name: For the tomato sauce: small onion and carrot

instructions.1: For the tomato sauce: sauté the vegetables in the ghee, then add the stock and tomatoes and cook until done; press through a sieve, add the cornflour mixed with a little water and boil for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring.
instructions.2: Prepare the meat as for chops and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs, deep-fry in plenty of ghee, then lift out and drain thoroughly.
instructions.4: Mix the spaghetti with a little tomato sauce, pile it in the center of the plate in a mound, sprinkle the grated cheese on top and arrange the fried chops around it.
instructions.5: Serve the rest of the tomato sauce alongside in a sauceboat.

osool-138.title: Curried Lamb Chops with Rice
osool-138.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Season the prepared meat with salt, pepper and curry powder.
instructions.2: For the curry sauce: fry a small onion in 1 tablespoon ghee, add curry powder and flour and stir, then add 1 cup stock while stirring, simmer over low heat and add a little lemon juice.
instructions.3: Coat the meat in egg and breadcrumbs and deep-fry in plenty of ghee.
instructions.4: Boil the rice and shape it on the plate into a hollow ring; arrange the chops inside the ring and fill the center with a little boiled rice.
instructions.5: Pour the curry sauce around the outside of the ring and serve hot.

osool-139.title: French-Style Chops
osool-139.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-139-i5.name: For the marinade: salt, pepper and nutmeg

instructions.1: Prepare the chops as for costoletta and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Mix the marinade ingredients, add the prepared chops and leave for a quarter of an hour, then lift them out and coat in breadcrumbs.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee until very hot and fry the chops, turning them quickly on both sides first, then lower the heat until cooked through; lift out and drain.
instructions.4: Serve on a layer of mashed potatoes with the tomato or brown sauce poured around, and put a paper frill on the end of each bone.

osool-140.title: Lamb Chops with Rumi Cheese Sauce
osool-140.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-140-i3.name: Grated rumi cheese (for the sauce and sprinkling)

instructions.1: Prepare the meat, season with salt and pepper, then fry in very hot ghee until half cooked.
instructions.2: Lift out, trim neatly and place a weight on the chops so they take an even shape; leave until completely cold.
instructions.3: Make the cheese sauce by adding 2 to 3 tablespoons grated cheese to the white sauce; coat both sides of the chops with it, sprinkle with grated cheese and leave to cool.
instructions.4: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and fry again in very hot ghee.
instructions.5: Arrange on a plate and garnish with the boiled potatoes brushed with warm ghee and covered with chopped parsley.

osool-141.title: Veal Steaks on Tomato Rounds with Mashed Potatoes
osool-141.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Prepare the meat by pounding and flattening it, season with salt and pepper, then fry in the ghee.
instructions.2: Make a bed of mashed potatoes, or pipe it into rosettes, one per steak, or into wide ribbons using a piping tube.
instructions.3: Place the tomato rounds on a greased tray and warm them in the oven for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Arrange the steaks on the bed and place a tomato round in the center of each.
instructions.5: Decorate each tomato round with a small rosette of mashed potato and serve the steaks with the sauce around them or alongside.

osool-142.title: Minced Meat Steaks with Onion Rings
osool-142.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Mix the minced meat with the parsley, seasoning and mashed potatoes if using, bind with the egg yolks and shape into round steaks.
instructions.2: Coat the steaks in flour and fry in very hot ghee, either deep or shallow.
instructions.3: Slice the onions into rings; separate the large outer rings and set them aside.
instructions.4: Chop the rest of the onion and fry it in 1 tablespoon ghee, then cover with some of the brown sauce and cook until tender.
instructions.5: Coat the onion rings in flour, dip them in egg white, then in flour again and fry.
instructions.6: Make a bed of mashed potatoes and arrange the steaks on it neatly; place a fried onion ring on each steak with a little of the onion and sauce mixture inside it, pour the remaining sauce around the plate and serve hot.

osool-143.title: Steaks and Balls from Cooked Minced Meat
osool-143.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

instructions.1: Mix the sauce with the cooked minced meat and parsley, knead well and season.
instructions.2: Spread in a round in a dish greased with ghee and leave to cool, then cut into 4 to 6 pieces and shape into rounds like steaks.
instructions.3: Coat in egg and breadcrumbs and deep-fry in plenty of very hot ghee.
instructions.4: Arrange the steaks on a plate and garnish with parsley, or serve on a bed of potato purée with tomato or brown sauce.
instructions.5: Meat balls on fried bread: shape the same mixture into balls, coat in egg and breadcrumbs and fry, and stick a small parsley stem into each ball so it looks like an apricot; cut white bread into 2.5 cm thick slices, then into 5 cm rounds with the center removed, fry them, and set each ball on a fried bread ring.

osool-144.title: Leftover Meat Fingers in Batter
osool-144.chapter: From Osool El Tahy (Principles of Cooking)

osool-144-i5.name: For the French batter: warm water

osool-144-i6.name: For the French batter: whisked egg white

instructions.1: Mix the ingredients, knead well and season.
instructions.2: Roll the mixture out and cut into 3 cm pieces, shaping them like bottle corks.
instructions.3: For the batter: sift the flour with salt, make a well in the center and add the oil, then add the water gradually while beating until smooth; leave for half an hour, and fold in the whisked egg white just before using.
instructions.4: Dust the shaped pieces with a little flour, then dip them in the batter.
instructions.5: Deep-fry, then lift out onto paper to absorb the ghee.
instructions.6: Garnish with parsley and serve with tomato sauce.
